name: The False Prophet
overview: Scripture warns believers to be vigilant against false prophets who claim to speak in God's name but instead prophesy lies and deceit from their own hearts, as revealed in Jeremiah 14:14 and 23:16. Jesus cautions that these false teachers may appear harmless, like sheep, but are inwardly dangerous wolves intent on leading many astray, even performing signs to deceive the elect (Matthew 7:15; 24:24). The New Testament further instructs Christians to identify and avoid those who cause divisions by contradicting sound doctrine (Romans 16:17). The imagery of the beast in Revelation 13 underscores the prophetic warning of deceptive powers aligned against God's truth.
